The sounds in Data\Sound\fo4bowling are cut from real bowling recordings on Freesound, released under CC0 1.0
(public domain) except the pinsetter (CC BY 4.0, credited below) and the announcer. They were converted to mono 44.1 kHz, trimmed, faded, de-hissed and levelled for the mod; the hits
are a pin knock layered with a pin-on-pin clack or two.

  crash_1, release_1
      "Bowling Ball Hits Pins, Once" by CHallSmith
      https://freesound.org/people/CHallSmith/sounds/870830/
  crash_2   "Bowling Strike" by SieuAmThanh
      https://freesound.org/people/SieuAmThanh/sounds/514385/
  crash_3   "SPRTInd-Int_BowlingStrike_Zus_OwSfx_Hard" by ZusIsKing
      https://freesound.org/people/ZusIsKing/sounds/766871/
  crash_4   "bowling (strike/spare)" by Raclure
      https://freesound.org/people/Raclure/sounds/458869/
  crash_5, crash_6
      "Bowling.wav" by Rehanjo
      https://freesound.org/people/Rehanjo/sounds/593593/
  hit_*     "Single bowling pin knock" by Rvgerxini, with "bowling pins stereo" by Bruce Burbank
      https://freesound.org/people/Rvgerxini/sounds/499788/
      https://freesound.org/people/Bruce%20Burbank/sounds/151204/
  roll_1, release_2
      "Bowling Ball.wav" by driftworks
      https://freesound.org/people/driftworks/sounds/128969/
  pin_*
      "bowling pins mono" by Bruce Burbank
      https://freesound.org/people/Bruce%20Burbank/sounds/151203/
  machine_1, set_*
      "Keilakoneisto, keilojen nosto / Bowling machine, lifting bowling pins" by YleArkisto (Yle Archives),
      licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); cut, filtered and levelled
      https://freesound.org/people/YleArkisto/sounds/367083/
  announce_*
      The alley PA's calls were made for the mod with Chatterbox by Resemble AI (MIT licence,
      https://github.com/resemble-ai/chatterbox), using a voice from Kokoro (Apache 2.0) as the speaker, then put
      through a horn-speaker filter and a hall echo. Chatterbox marks its audio with an inaudible Perth watermark.
